solutions.title: Length buckets with wildcard scan
solutions.strategy: Group inserted words by length and compare a query only with candidates of the same length.

timeComplexity.explanation: A search may compare k same-length words, each across L characters.

spaceComplexity.explanation: All inserted words are stored in length buckets.

solutions.title: Trie wildcard backtracking
solutions.strategy: Store words in a trie and recursively branch over child nodes only when the query character is a dot.

timeComplexity.explanation: In the worst case w wildcard positions can branch across many children while scanning L characters.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The trie stores the distinct inserted prefix paths.
